sources.articleTitle: Fire Dept: Six, including baby, escape unharmed as early morning fire destroys three Nibong Tebal houses

headline: Fire In Nibong Tebal Destroys Three Homes, No Injuries Reported
metaDescription: A fire in Nibong Tebal destroyed three houses, but all six occupants, including an infant, escaped the scene without suffering any physical injuries.
aiSummaryBullets: A residential fire occurred in Nibong Tebal early in the morning.
Three homes were completely destroyed by the blaze.
Six residents, including a baby, evacuated safely without any reported injuries.
aiContextParagraph: Emergency services in Nibong Tebal responded to a residential fire early on the morning of November 14, 2026. The incident resulted in the total destruction of three homes. According to reports from the local fire department, a total of six individuals were inside the affected structures at the time the fire began. Among those present was a six-month-old infant. All six occupants managed to vacate the premises successfully before the blaze consumed the buildings. Officials have confirmed that there were no injuries sustained by the residents during the event. The situation remains under observation as local authorities continue to process the aftermath of the property damage. This incident highlights ongoing concerns regarding fire safety in residential areas, though no specific cause for the ignition has been publicly identified or confirmed by the authorities involved in the response efforts as of the latest updates.
whyItIsViral: The story has gained attention due to high local search interest for the term 'kebakaran' in Malaysia, suggesting significant public concern regarding the fire.
